mechanism: Ranolazine is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase primaquine plasma concentrations, while both drugs carry independent risks of cardiac arrhythmias and hemolytic effects in G6PD-deficient patients.
action: Monitor for increased primaquine toxicity (hemolysis, methemoglobinemia) and cardiac effects; consider dose adjustment or alternative antimalarial if possible, especially in G6PD-deficient patients.
